tracking: ADR-0358 (lane E39): API-only by the lane brief (rule 3); the adoption analytics screen is for the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/adoption/active-users: shows metered active users per AI tool over time (day, week or month), optionally per team or project; small cohorts suppressed
gaps.GET /v1/adoption/top-tools: ranks the AI tools in use by active users (metered) and, separately, imported vendors by active accounts
gaps.GET /v1/adoption/seats: shows seat utilisation per vendor from imported lines: licensed, active, idle and active without a seat
gaps.GET /v1/adoption/people: the per-person adoption ranking, refused unless an admin turned it on; each read is audited
gaps.GET /v1/adoption/policy: shows the adoption privacy policy (per-person ranking, minimum cohort size) against its strict defaults
gaps.PUT /v1/adoption/policy: sets the adoption privacy policy; relaxing it needs a step-up and a reason, and is audited
